disease_scope_review.endpoint_excerpt: The only statistically significant associations observed with nutrients were weak inverse associations for palmitoleic acid ( p trend 0.04), fatty acid 17:1 ( p trend 0.04), and 20:5 n-6 ( p trend 0.05); and a non-significant trend for oleic acid ( p trend 0.09).
disease_scope_review.reason: The palmitoleic-acid association concerns the study's prostate cancer endpoint, with no abstract-supported aggressive classification.
